text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 94 McNicoll Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is because the tree is hazardous, in poor condition, and its pollen is causing an allergic reaction. The subject tree is a horse chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum), measuring 31 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one privately owned tree located at 94 McNicoll Avenue.
